name: Gulf State Park Pier
address: 20800 East Beach Blvd, Gulf Shores, AL 36542

milestones.title: Decking and railings upgraded
milestones.detail: Hardwood decking and railings were installed before landfall for durability. Their effect on storm damage is unknown.

milestones.title: Sally damages the pier
milestones.detail: The state reports that the storm destroyed a 200-foot section and caused other damage.

milestones.title: Partial reopening
milestones.detail: Approximately 725 feet reopened. The more heavily damaged southern portion remained closed.

milestones.title: Rebuilt pier reopens
milestones.detail: The renovated pier returned to service after a separate construction closure that began in November 2023.

economics.label: State-reported project total
economics.detail: Rounded total for the completed repair and enhancement project.

economics.label: Federal funding obligated
economics.detail: OpenFEMA disaster 4563, worksheet 510. This amount describes a federal funding commitment.

economics.label: Verified storm-only payments
economics.detail: The final paid total attributable specifically to storm damage remains unknown.
